summary: Frontend-only mobile testing (375x667) for My Duwit Gwejh executed end-to-end against https://cost-counter-234.preview.emergentagent.com. All major flows PASS: tab navigation (home/history/reports/settings), FAB opens Add modal, amount + note inputs, auto-categorization keywords (game→HIBURAN & LIFESTYLE, shopee→BELANJA ONLINE, bensin→TRANSPORTASI, listrik→TAGIHAN) with visible auto-category-banner, manual category chip override clears the banner, save-transaction persists and appears on dashboard. History filters (hist-days-7/30/60/90, hist-month-0..11, hist-type-all/income/expense) all render and are clickable. Export modal opens with periode cepat / month / custom range fields (export-custom-start/-end accept YYYY-MM-DD), export-pdf and export-csv buttons clickable (native share not required on web). Reports tab renders score-gauge and bar-chart SVGs; pie-chart renders when expense data present and hides with 'Belum cukup data' otherwise; empty month correctly shows 'Belum Ada Data' (never 'Boros'); after adding Rp 5.000.000 income + Rp 1.000.000 expense the current month shows Score 100 with 'Sangat Hemat'. All 4 achievements rows present (Konsisten 3 Bulan, Legenda Hemat 12 bulan, Rajin Mencatat 7 hari, Langkah Pertama 30 transaksi). Settings: profile edit persists name (verified 'Halo, Bagus' on dashboard after save); wallpaper page shows all 6 preset tiles (obsidian/emerald/ocean/plum/ember/slate) and pick-wallpaper-from-gallery button; support page shows donation-qr image and 'Kenean Store' text. Delete transaction: long-press/tap delete-<id> opens ConfirmModal, cancel-confirm keeps and do-confirm removes. Clear-all: settings-clear-all → do-confirm empties list and shows 'Semua catatan telah dihapus' toast. AsyncStorage persistence verified: added 2 transactions, reloaded page, both records reappeared. Wallpaper persistence verified: after selecting 'ember' and reload localStorage still contains {presetId:'ember',...} and backdrop rendered on all four tabs. No red screen, no deprecated Expo packages (expo-av/barcode-scanner/background-fetch not used). Non-blocking console warnings: react-native-web deprecation for 'shadow*' style props and a react-native-svg 'transform-origin' DOM prop warning.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Non-blocking on web but should migrate shadow* → boxShadow for React Native Web compatibility.
Console error on web: 'Invalid DOM property transform-origin'. react-native-svg emits kebab-case attribute in the web renderer. Non-blocking, gauges/bars still render, but should be tracked upstream.

action_items: Optional: replace shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius with the unified boxShadow style to silence React Native Web deprecation warning.
Optional: harden ImagePicker gallery flow (pickPhoto & pick-wallpaper-from-gallery) with try/finally so isPicking always resets and user sees a toast on native error (carry-over from iteration_5).
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx is 2326 lines and contains Dashboard, History, Reports, Settings, Profile, Wallpaper, Support, Add/Export/Confirm modals and utilities all in a single file. Consider splitting into per-screen components under app/(tabs)/ or src/screens/ for maintainability.
Wallpaper backdrop is mounted once at the root and covers every tab correctly — good architectural choice.
Auto-categorization keyword map order is respectful (BELANJA ONLINE before BELANJA, specific keywords before generic ones) — verified live via shopee/bensin/listrik/game.
Score gauge correctly returns null/'Belum Ada Data' for empty months and computes on real data — verified with 5M income + 1M expense yielding Score 100 'Sangat Hemat'.
seed_data_creation: Session-scoped test seeds only (belanja bulanan 1.000.000 + gaji 5.000.000). Removed via clear-all before finishing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All testIDs listed in the review request are present and functional. Web preview cannot exercise expo-print/expo-sharing native side; test scripts only verify that export buttons are clickable. Each mcp_browser_automation invocation appears to spawn a fresh browser context, so localStorage does NOT persist across tool calls; persistence must be tested with page.reload() inside a single script call as done here.
rca_of_issue: No functional issues found. React Native Web 'shadow*' deprecation and react-native-svg 'transform-origin' warnings are cosmetic console noise from web-only rendering; they will not appear on iOS/Android native builds and do not break any user-facing feature.
